name: __MSG_extName__
_comment_permissions: storage: persist user rules + trading state. alarms: heartbeat for 18:00 ET daily reset. notifications: alert when an order is blocked. sidePanel: primary UI surface. webRequest: capture Bearer token from Tradovate API headers (never leaves the browser).
_comment_host_permissions: Required: read Tradovate API request headers (Authorization: Bearer) to capture the auth token securely via chrome.webRequest.onSendHeaders. The extension makes exactly ONE startup fetch to Tradovate per session (syncFromTradovate), then operates passively. Anonymous product-usage analytics are sent to Google Analytics 4 via the Measurement Protocol (no personal or financial data). nfs.faireconomy.media: ForexFactory economic calendar CDN — one fetch at startup to load this week's high-impact news events.
_comment_optional_permissions: scripting + TradingView origins: requested at runtime via chrome.permissions.request() after explicit user consent in the 'Enable Protection' screen. Used to register content scripts that intercept order requests. Without these, the extension is inert.
